audit.why: 50.53% over 1322 games with 7.5/10 difficulty is defensible: nothing is free, K'Sante owns level 2, Gangplank gets exactly one clean window at first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts disagreed with the packet chart at six of seven rows, and with the page's own whys at every one of them: Level 1 given to Gangplank when whys[0] says K'Sante wins short trades, Level 2 called Skill when whys[1] says 'concede this stage', Levels 3 and 4-5 given to K'Sante when whys[2] and whys[3] both say even, Level 6 given to Gangplank when whys[4] says even, and First item given to K'Sante when whys[5] says Gangplank out-bursts him.
audit.why: The chart was telling the player the opposite of the paragraph beside it at almost every stage — including handing him Level 6 against a tank.
audit.corrected: win[0..5] and phases[0..5].side/.rating/.why brought onto the packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page has K'Sante's W and E swapped and misdescribes his Q. It repeatedly says 'his W gives him a charged shield-dash' and tells you to 'bait his W shield' — the shield is Footwork (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s); Path Maker (W) is the charged dash that knocks back and stuns and deals TRUE damage. It also calls Ntofo Strikes a 'slam that knocks up' in five places — Ntofo Strikes slows, and at two stacks fires a shockwave that PULLS you in, on a 3.5s cooldown. Finally tldr, report[0] and dosFull[2].t say 'Q-cleanse': Gangplank cleanses with Remove Scurvy (W).
audit.why: The player is told to bait the wrong ability, to expect a knockup that never comes instead of a pull, and to hold the wrong button against a stun. Path Maker's true damage also means the Plated Steelcaps on the page do nothing against his biggest hit.
audit.corrected: whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.you[0], wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], tldr, report[0], report[5], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull rebuilt on the real kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] says buy anti-heal 'early — his healing fights your pattern'.
audit.why: K'Sante's only healing is on All Out (R), so anti-heal does nothing before he is level 6. The buy is right, the timing was wrong.
audit.corrected: report[8] and breakdown.late retimed to his level 6 / All Out.

edits.before: K'Sante's early is the part that scares you — his passive Dauntless Instinct adds bonus damage on his abilities and his W charges a shield he dashes with, so he can walk up and free-hit your kegs before you can chain them. Don't place a single barrel where his W-dash or Q can reach it; set them off to the side and only pop them with Parrrley from max range so he can't body-block the explosion. Last-hit with Q and accept that levels 1-3 are his window, not yours. Hold W (Remove Scurvy) for when he lands the Q knockup, not for chip — it cleanses the lockdown that sets up his whole all-in and heals you off your missing health.
edits.after: K'Sante's early is the part that scares you — Dauntless Instinct marks you for bonus damage on his next attack, and Path Maker (W) charges up taking reduced damage before it dashes, stuns and lands true damage, so armour does not save you. Don't place a barrel where that dash or Ntofo Strikes can reach it; set them off to the side and pop them with Parrrley from max range so he can't body-block the explosion. Last-hit with Q and accept that levels 1-3 are his. Hold Remove Scurvy (W) for the Path Maker stun, not for chip — that lockdown sets up his whole all-in. Ntofo Strikes only pulls at two stacks, so step out and break the count.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 you stabilize as your second E point comes up and you can finally chain two kegs — start landing Parrrley-into-keg poke whenever he steps up to farm, because his only lane sustain is base regen and his W shield. At 6, Cannon Barrage isn't a duel button against a tank, so use it to zone him off the wave and deny his W-dash engage rather than to finish. Bait his W shield on a fake keg, then commit the real chain while it's down — that's the only mid-game window where your burst beats his shield-and-dash.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 you stabilize as your second E point comes up and you can finally chain two kegs — start landing Parrrley-into-keg poke whenever he steps up to farm, because before All Out his only lane sustain is base regen and Footwork's shield. At 6, Cannon Barrage isn't a duel button against a tank, so use it to zone him off the wave and deny his Path Maker engage rather than to finish. Bait Footwork on a fake keg, then commit the real chain in the 10 seconds before it returns — that's the only mid-game window where your burst beats his shield-and-dash.

notes: The biggest defect here was a swapped W/E: the page told the player five times to bait 'his W shield', but the shield is Footwork (E) and Path Maker (W) is the true-damage charged stun. That also invalidates the Plated Steelcaps logic against his signature hit, which I noted in the itemisation reasoning rather than changing the boots. dosFull[2].t reads 'Q-cleanse his slows' — wrong ability AND he slows with Ntofo Strikes not a generic slow — but at 19 characters it falls under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so it needs a manual fix. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Powder Kegs' in wants.foe[1]: false positive.
